0022600005.text: Both the Golden State Warriors and the Los Angeles Lakers open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Warriors visiting Los Angeles. Golden State's absences are Jimmy Butler III (out, knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (out, undisclosed), and Moses Moody (out, knee surgery), while Brandin Podziemski (back), Charles Bassey (knee), and Stephen Curry (ankle sprain) are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The Lakers are also dealing with day-to-day, game-time decisions for Adou Thiero (undisclosed), Bronny James (illness), Cameron Carr (bruise), Collin Sexton (lower leg), and Jarred Vanderbilt (undisclosed), and the Warriors lost 1-3 to them in the 2025-26 season, including a 119-103 loss in San Francisco on April 9, 2026.
